error_reason: FileSurfer claimed a successful download to a placeholder path and 'opened' a generic 'Download complete' page instead of a verifiable book file, without validating existence, type, or content. This misled subsequent steps to repeatedly target a non-existent local copy, blocking access to the actual page 11 endnote and forcing a guess. Correctly verifying the download and opening the real file would have enabled finding the endnote date.

hypotheses.rationale: FileSurfer reported a generic 'Download complete' to '/workspace/path_to_local_copy_of_the_book' without actually opening, listing, or verifying the downloaded file’s contents or type. This created a fictitious local path that the Orchestrator then repeatedly targeted, leading to a loop and culminating in an uninformed guess (23). Had FileSurfer either opened a real file, confirmed its existence and format (e.g., a PDF), or reported failure to obtain the book content, the system could have corrected course and accessed the actual page 11 endnote. This is the earliest step where doing the right validation would have prevented the downstream wrong answer.
hypotheses.check: Verify whether any actual file matching the book (e.g., a PDF of the JSTOR item) existed at '/workspace/path_to_local_copy_of_the_book' after step 16. Check if FileSurfer had the capability or instructions to download from JSTOR and whether it confirmed file metadata (size, type) or previewed content. Compare step 16 with subsequent repeated accesses (steps 20, 24, 28, 32) to confirm the same placeholder path was reused without content verification.

evidence.discrepancy: Step 16 claims a successful download and a saved file at '/workspace/path_to_local_copy_of_the_book', but subsequent attempts to open it only show a generic 'Download complete' page with no actual book content, pagination, or verification of file type/metadata. This indicates the claimed download and saved file were not real or not validated.
